maya: heads-up — regen on `release/flutter-sdk` failed CI after the package bump to v1.2.0. appears to be two things: changelog-lint and a typegen signature change. error excerpt:
```
Error: changelog.md: line 12: invalid entry format
Typegen diff: src/flutter/api.dart: change `String? prefix` -> `String prefix`
Command: npm run regen && npm run lint:changelog
Exit code: 1
```
sam: ouch. did someone intentionally make that param required? @emily did you review the openapi patch? :eyes:
emily: i thought it was a docs-only change, so i set semver: minor. but the openapi diff actually tightened the schema for `getSuggestions` — optional -> required. that is breaking for SDKs.
lee: can you paste the full typegen diff? i'll run the typegen locally with the same node version as CI and confirm formatting.
maya: pasted the minimal diff above. my local run of `yarn typegen --write` rewrote a few whitespace things which then tripped `lint:changelog` because our changelog linter checks section headers. exact failing command I ran:
```
export NODE_ENV=ci && yarn && yarn typegen --write && npm run lint:changelog
```
ci-bot: [build 8731] FAILURE on release/flutter-sdk — `lint:changelog` failed (see logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/8731) :x:
sam: choices: revert the openapi change (if it was accidental), or do a semver-major bump (v2.0.0) and include a BREAKING CHANGE entry + migration note in changelog. also update SDKs to reflect new required param.
emily: i dug through usage across repos — callers observed in 3 internal repos and one partner integration. reverting is not great unless we want to unship the schema fix. i'm leaning to bumping to major and doing a careful release. we'll need a migration snippet.
maya: i'll open a PR that does the following: bump to v2.0.0, add a `BREAKING CHANGES` subsection in changelog with migration example, run `yarn typegen --write` and include that committed regen, and run `npm run lint:changelog --fix` before pushing. i'll tag @release-engineering for the release approval. :hammer_and_wrench:
sam: sgtm. please also add a small `sdk: flutter` header so our publish tooling picks up platform notes. maybe include a sample snippet showing new call site with required param.
emily: perfect — if CI still flakes after your push ping me, i'll allocate our dedicated runner and approve a manual release candidate. thanks for the quick triage. :thumbsup:
lee: once PR is up i'll run a local matrix to validate typegen across node 18/20 and dart versions.
maya: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/release/pull/412 — contains changelog + typegen regen. running CI now.
